description: Change of use from storage to the rear of 276 Bath Road to additional ancillary seating for an existing restaurant (Use Class A3) at 274 Bath Road with internal alterations
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan and Existing Ground Floor Plan and Elevations received on 12 April 2019. Proposed Ground Floor Plan and Elevations, and Proposed Roof Plan received on 11 June 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for ancillary seating for an A3 restaurant shall not be open to customers outside the following times:
Midday to 11:00pm on weekdays and Saturdays; and
Midday to 9:00pm on Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times:
Midday to 11:00pm on weekdays and Saturdays; and
Midday to 9:00pm on Sundays and Public Holidays.

Condition : 5 - The southern portion of no. 276 Bath Road annotated as 'Additional restaurant seating' on the plan C01 Revision B by GC Architecture is only to be used as ancillary seating in conjunction with a restaurant at no. 274 Bath Road. At no time shall this additional restaurant seating be used as an independent restaurant.
Condition : 6 - The use of the retail premises at the street frontage of 276 Bath Road premises shall only be used as a retail unit (A1) and shall not be used for the sale of food.
